subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop scanner findings configurable per workspace or trusted skill

question: Should Skill Workshop permit critical scanner findings through a one-proposal operator override, a persistent scoped policy, or no override at all?
rationale: The choice determines whether a heuristic scanner remains an absolute gate and how much durable trust may be delegated by workspace, skill identity, rule, content hash, and actor.

options.title: Hash-bound override
options.body: Allow an operator to acknowledge and apply one exact proposal, invalidating the approval whenever its content or findings change.

options.title: Persistent scoped policy
options.body: Add rule-and-skill configuration with visible audit annotations, accepting the greater risk of stale trust after skill or content changes.

options.title: Keep absolute blocking
options.body: Reject overrides and address false positives only by improving scanner rules and quarantine revision or dismissal flows.

recommendation.title: Hash-bound override
recommendation.body: Allow an operator to acknowledge and apply one exact proposal, invalidating the approval whenever its content or findings change.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer-scoped scanner trust-model request explicitly preserved Workshop scanning and provides the strongest available policy-ownership signal.
